w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE REDACTOR! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: It's settled. The village is calling it "Old Gavel." The Codex keeps it.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Terms of Service is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: You catch fragments by the fire — Nikos telling Everett about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
A cart-driver with flour on their sleeves waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.

loss.line: No one is left to pick up the Codex. The village dies out — quietly, the way villages do. The season ends here.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,104 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
